sequences.name: Savant
sequences.potion_overview: Appears to be a very delicious and very sweet looking icy blue liquid.

main_ingredients: The Brain core of a High Mountain Snowman
The Crystalline Matter of a Library Shadow Spirit
supplementary_ingredients: 100 milliliters of High Mountain Snowman blood
1 item bearing stains of a Library Shadow Spirit
1 basic education textbook
1 piece of a Carnelian

main_ingredients: The Crystallization of an Ancient Tomb Shadow
The Spinal Cord of a Ruin Wanderer (a humanoid creature)
supplementary_ingredients: 20 grams of Ancient Tomb Shadow dust
150 milliliters of Ruin Wanderer blood
1 ancient document of value
1 ancient item with a little mystical power (Choosing the wrong one could be very dangerous)

sequences.name: Appraiser
sequences.potion_overview: A liquid of intertwining black and white.

supplementary_ingredients: 9 drops of tears from the Spirit World Evil Eye
100 milliliters of blood from the 'Human-Skin Ancient Scroll'
1 type illustrated handbook
9 drops of mint essential oil

sequences.name: Artisan (Machinery Specialist)
sequences.potion_overview: It is as if composed of crimson flames, yet various iron-black objects float within.

main_ingredients: The Cerebrum of a Four-Armed Madman
The Tinder of a Carnivorous Furnace
supplementary_ingredients: 150 milliliters of Four-Armed Madman blood
30 grams of ashes from the Carnivorous Furnace
1 piece of personally polished gear or another mechanical component
1 newly conceived mechanical design drawing, free from major errors

sequences.name: Astronomer (Astromancer)
sequences.potion_overview: A liquid reflecting a dreamy starry sky.

main_ingredients: The Eyes of a Star marked Elephant Man
The Crystal shell of an Enchanted Dancing Giant Turtle
supplementary_ingredients: 200 milliliters of a Star marked Elephant Man blood
3 fragments of ordinary shell from the Enchanted Dancing Giant Turtle
1 complete set of convex and concave lenses
10 drops of Starflower hydrolat

sequences.advancement_ritual: Discover and name an astronomical phenomenon or a celestial body.

sequences.name: Alchemist
sequences.potion_overview: A viscous black liquid divided into several parts with no parts connecting. It's like frozen black porridge that had been cut by a blade.

main_ingredients: 1 Heart of a Soul Eater (a humanoid creature)
supplementary_ingredients: 100 milliliters of Soul Eater blood
1 core component of a mechanical construct belonging to a Spirit of Machinery
1 piece of one's own flesh and blood
1 item symbolizing good fortune

sequences.advancement_ritual: Extract all life force within a designated area; causing the soil to desertify, and the lakes to dry up.

sequences.name: Arcane Scholar (Demon of Arcana)
sequences.potion_overview: A transparent liquid in which sparks unceasingly appear and vanish.

supplementary_ingredients: Choose one of: 1 type of combustible material from the Spirit World Star-Fire OR 30 grams of dust from the Annihilation Ghost OR 40 grams of dust from an Arcane Scholar
1 object once possessed by an Arcane Scholar
90 milliliters of water contaminated by the Spirit World
50 grams of a highly radioactive material

sequences.advancement_ritual: Select a certain special Spirit World knowledge and find a way to establish a close connection with it, achieving integration at the spiritual level. Note: 'Certain special Spirit World knowledge' refers to knowledge that can contaminate you, lock onto you, or knowledge that has come to life.

sequences.name: Knowledge Magister (Master)
sequences.potion_overview: An icy liquid stretched into a distorted humanoid shape.

main_ingredients: 1 'Otherworldly Brain' (a brain-like creature capable of creating a realm with physical rules that differ from reality)
supplementary_ingredients: 5,000 milliliters of water from the 'Knowledge Sea' formed after the death of a Knowledge Magister or the 'Otherworldly Brain'
One copy of one's own work that has been cited or utilized by more than 100,000 people (recorded on paper)
A blessing from any of the Seven Lights of the Spirit World
Heartfelt tokens of gratitude from different students of the concoctor (at least 1,000)

sequences.advancement_ritual: Make a groundbreaking and systematically outstanding contribution in any existing field.

sequences.name: Illuminator (Civilization Enlightener, Light of Darkness)
sequences.potion_overview: A pool of black liquid with a faint but clear radiance shining from within.

supplementary_ingredients: 100,000 souls of those who perished during a civilization's decline
1 History book recording a civilization
1 of the most outstanding mechanical creations from a civilization (must be near perfect)
12 miniature idols sculpted by one's students out of worship and faith

sequences.advancement_ritual: Popularize new knowledge to promote the civilizational renewal of at least one country.

sequences.name: Paragon
sequences.potion_overview: A flawless, ethereal humanoid form emitting a faint glow.

supplementary_ingredients: Knowledge gleaned from the Aura or remnants of the Great Old Ones

sequences.advancement_ritual: Nurture a Civilization, witnessing and recording its entire process from enlightenment, development and prosperity to decline, demise or replacement. Note: A regional civilization is sufficient. The main point is the long duration, and it cannot be interrupted.
